content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for SINP Medical Officer (Contractual) Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the SINP Medical Officer (Contractual) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 31 August 2026. It is advisable to send your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from an institution recognized by the National Medical Commission (NMC) and hold a valid registration with the State Medical Council or National Medical Register.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any experience required for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, a minimum of 3 years of post-MBBS clinical experience is desirable, preferably in an institutional dispensary or hospital OPD setting, covering general outpatient care and emergency management.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying?
faq.answer: The age limit for candidates applying for the Medical Officer (Contractual) position is not exceeding 67 years as of the application closing date.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Medical Officer (Contractual) position at the Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Full-Time Medical Officer role?
faq.answer: For the Full-Time Medical Officer position, the remuneration is ₹ 75,000/- per month. For Part-Time roles, remuneration will be on a pro-rata basis.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email. The application, along with self-attested copies of testimonials, should be sent to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics located?
faq.answer: Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics is located in Kolkata, West Bengal, with the pincode 700064.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer (Contractual) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process may involve a Written Test/Skill Assessment, if deemed necessary by the institute, followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with a postgraduate degree apply?
faq.answer: Yes, a postgraduate degree or diploma (MD/DNB/DGO/Diploma) in General Medicine, Family Medicine, or an allied clinical discipline is desirable, although not mandatory.
